body:
Not goodbye (not even CLOSE), but I will be WAY less active in game, as I can only play on fridays, saturdays, and sundays. This also goes for my brother, _garrett_rocks_, who more people know than me, but yeah. I'll always have skype open, if your my friend, and you want my phone number... Ask, cause I'll give it and I will alwayd respond (unless I'm in school, I'll respond as soon as i get out!). But yeah, that's about it. Ima try and make some maps... Idk, we shall see. See ya later! Thanks for a great summer!!!! 

                          -JJ
